title: Sunscope — Analysis
description: Window functions and CTEs over the telemetry: moving averages, lag, distribution ranking and event rollups. The same SQL is documented in docs/06-sql-examples.md.

list.name: inverter
list.label: Inverter
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT inverter_id FROM inverter_telemetry WHERE site = 'mojave' ORDER BY inverter_id
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT inverter_id FROM inverter_telemetry WHERE site = 'mojave' ORDER BY inverter_id

panels.title: Power with a 4-tick moving average (ROWS)
panels.description: ROWS counts rows, so the window is 4 samples regardless of elapsed time. Docs example A4. The time picker drives the range via $__timeFilter, so the panel shows the selected window rather than a fixed 6 hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, "ac_power_w" AS raw, AVG("ac_power_w") OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS smoothed FROM inverter_telemetry WHERE site = 'mojave' AND inverter_id IN (${inverter:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Period-over-period change (LAG)
panels.description: First difference of the 15-minute mean, which is where a sudden loss shows up before it moves the daily total. Docs example A2. The CTE bins first so the lag compares equal intervals.

targets.rawSql: WITH binned AS (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '15 minutes', time) AS time, inverter_id, AVG("ac_power_w") AS avg_power_w FROM inverter_telemetry WHERE site = 'mojave' AND inverter_id IN (${inverter:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, inverter_id) SELECT time, inverter_id, avg_power_w, avg_power_w - LAG(avg_power_w) OVER (PARTITION BY inverter_id ORDER BY time) AS change_w FROM binned ORDER BY time

panels.title: Fleet ranking by mean efficiency (CUME_DIST)
panels.description: CUME_DIST places each inverter in the fleet distribution, so you can see not just the best performer but how far ahead it is. Docs example A6.

targets.rawSql: SELECT inverter_id, ROUND(AVG("efficiency"), 4) AS mean_eff, ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY AVG("efficiency")), 3) AS percentile FROM inverter_telemetry WHERE site = 'mojave' AND inverter_id IN (${inverter:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY inverter_id ORDER BY mean_eff DESC

panels.title: Events by severity and source (CTE)
panels.description: Aggregate rollup over the events table. Docs example E9.

targets.rawSql: WITH recent AS (SELECT time, severity, source, code FROM events WHERE site = 'mojave' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT severity, source, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(time) AS latest FROM recent GROUP BY severity, source ORDER BY n DESC
